After Discover, the client considers only the card's interfaces on the NewClient scheme, host and port (default ports filled in); of those it calls the first JSON-RPC interface serving the client version, otherwise the first JSON-RPC one
The chosen interface contributes its path, version and tenant; an interface at the default /a2a keeps the base URL
A different host or port is not followed; calls go to {base}/a2a with a warning logged once; http interface on the https base host is not warned about
Without a card or with no interfaces, calls go to {base}/a2a
